text:
```yaml
name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout PSWriteOffice repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice
          path: PSWriteOffice
          ref: main

      - name: Build website
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot "${{ github.workspace }}\PSWriteOffice"

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: Website/_site

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
